citation.authors: Kim MJ, Forlini C, Kremsreiter K

cited_by.title: Low haemoglobin, low or high white cells: causes, thresholds and pregnancy

record.population: Adults and children in a US primary care review
record.finding: Neutropenia is an absolute neutrophil count under 1,500 per microlitre in adults and children over 1 year, classed mild (1,000 to 1,500), moderate (500 to 999) or severe (under 500). Causes include autoimmune and drug-induced neutropenia, infection, chemotherapy, blood cancers, nutritional deficiency (vitamin B12, folate, copper) and inherited forms. Febrile neutropenia (fever with a count under 500) is an oncology emergency.
